# graviteeam_role (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Role

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_role" "example" {
  domain_id    = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name         = "ADMIN"
  description  = "Administrator role"
  oauth_scopes = ["openid", "profile", "email"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this role belongs to
- `name` (String) The name of the role

### Optional

- `assignable_type` (String) The assignable type: DOMAIN or APPLICATION
- `description` (String) The description of the role
- `oauth_scopes` (List of String) List of OAuth2 scopes associated with this role
- `permissions` (List of String) List of permissions for this role

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the role
